en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a multi‑storey historic tower surrounded by trees and an outdoor seating area with many wooden chairs and tables in the foreground. The tower has small rectangular windows with shutters on the lower levels, arched windows on the upper level, and an onion‑shaped dome with a lantern on top. Printed text at the top identifies the location as Graz and names the tower.
